design.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original 2D pixel-art knight character design, the identity reference for later game animations.
Primary request: design a beautifully drawn medieval knight with a mace in the right hand (screen left) and shield on the left arm (screen right). This is the FIRST design stage. Invent the 2D character directly; there is NO 3D model to trace. Attractive classic hand-pixeled game sprite with a rounded greathelm, narrow dark visor, small red crest, curved steel pauldrons, deep red cloth tabard, restrained warm brass trim, leather gloves and boots, and a readable shield emblem.
Composition: one complete character only, relaxed ready stance, three-quarter view facing slightly screen left, both feet visible, shield held beside torso so chest and legs are readable, mace pointing down. Fixed square canvas intended as exactly 128x128 logical pixels enlarged 8x to 1024x1024. Character crown around y=27, soles around y=108, center x=64, generous blank margins. Empty regions pure #FF00FF magenta key background.
Pixel art quality: deliberately authored coherent 2D pixel clusters; clean 1-logical-pixel dark stepped contours; crisp 2-3-tone material ramps; sculpted readable face/helmet, hands and boots; limited shared palette about 20-24 colors; attractive silhouette and pleasing proportions; the actual pixels must be large consistent square blocks at one common 8x grid. No tiny decorative noise. Render like a finished 2D game sprite, not a pixelated 3D model.
Avoid: realistic rendering, voxel or low-poly style, faceted block armor, smooth gradients, antialiasing, blur, dithering, texture speckles, fake pixel detail below the logical grid, floor, shadow, grid lines, text, watermark, extra views, duplicated characters.
